title: HFAS event envelope (v1)
description: Base envelope every telemetry event extends. PII policy: properties MUST NOT contain raw PII (names, IDs, phone, doc contents). Use hashed/aggregate identifiers. **REQUIRES LEGAL REVIEW** for any new identifier.

eventId.description: Unique per event; used for dedupe.

anonymousId.description: Persisted in localStorage; never joinable to national IDs.

traceId.description: W3C trace-id; joins telemetry to API/server logs.
